summary: A primary action, in six variants, three sizes and four shapes, with loading, icon-only and hold-to-confirm states.

props.name: icon
props.description: A glyph beside the label. Pass the icon and nothing else; the base gap spaces it for you. With `iconOnly` it becomes the whole button, so give that one an `aria-label`.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Drops the label and draws the icon alone, keeping the label as the accessible name. Needs `icon`: without one there would be nothing left to show, so the prop has no effect.

props.name: hold
props.description: Acts only once the button has been held down, for `true` 1.5 seconds or for this many milliseconds. A stronger color sweeps across while it is held and drains back if it is let go early. Space and Enter hold too.

props.name: holdLabel
props.description: What the button says for a moment once a hold completes.

props.name: onHold
props.description: Called once a hold completes. A held button never calls `onClick`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight. `primary` for the main action on a view, `danger` for destructive ones.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Swaps the icon for a spinner, dims the button and blocks interaction, while leaving it focusable: `aria-busy` and `aria-disabled` rather than the native `disabled` attribute, which would drop the control out of the tab order while a reader is waiting on it.

props.name: transition
props.description: The hover and focus transition. Turn it off for a static button, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it along with the danger, error and success tints that ride with it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.
